BiblicalUsage: Shalmaneser was the king of Assyria who ended the northern kingdom. He came up against Hoshea and made him his servant, and in the fourth year of Hezekiah he came up against Samaria and besieged it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Assyria was God's rod, and Shalmaneser was the hand that held it. The king who ended Samaria is a warning that no kingdom stands when God sends its conqueror.
RelatedPeople: Shalmaneser, King of Assyria; King Hezekiah
